labGamePage.title: Log Defense
labGamePage.noBuildable: No building available at current Town Hall level
labGamePage.demolishConfirm: Demolish this building? Assigned villagers return; no material refund.
labGamePage.noBuilding: No buildings available — upgrade the base or demolish one
labGamePage.wallDesc: Stone walls around the village against night raids. Each segment upgrades separately; defense scales with durability, wears down in raids, repair with cobblestone
labGamePage.whFull: Warehouse full, overflow left where it was
labGamePage.villEmpty: No villagers in the village yet
labGamePage.equipTakeOffHint: Villager loses the bonus after unequipping (durability resets, treated as re-fitting)
labGamePage.equipEmptyTip: No equippable item of this kind in the warehouse
labGamePage.equipRestoreHint: Restore slot: once equipped with a Golden Apple/Potion, tap the slot to use it and heal
labGamePage.feedAllNone: All villagers are full or no food available
labGamePage.queueStart: A builder is free — queued job started!
labGamePage.devWaveNo: Challenge not on — enable it in the raid panel first
labGamePage.craftHint: Minecraft crafting-table recipes — craft instantly when materials are ready; blocked while the warehouse is full
labGamePage.heroDesc: Assign her to any workstation to replace its villagers — the plot runs at full staff & full power
labGamePage.heroCostHint: 24h hire: {n} satiety (20 villagers' daily share) · warehouse can cover {have}
labGamePage.heroHired: Log Maiden hired! Assign her from any building detail
labGamePage.heroIdleHint: Unassigned — open any building detail to assign her
labGamePage.heroAssigned: Log Maiden assigned to the workstation
labGamePage.heroGone: Log Maiden's contract ended, the workstation is free
labGamePage.expHint: Send villagers into the Nether for rewards based on route and duration; recalling early only brings back part of the loot
labGamePage.expCostHint: Rations: {n} satiety (paid once from food by priority)
labGamePage.expWearHint: Expeditions wear weapon/armor durability by the wear rate (breaks at zero; better materials last longer); restoratives may be used when hurt; a fallen villager's gear is lost with them
labGamePage.portalDanger: Hazard duty: stationed members lose {h} HP and {w} equipment durability per hour (items break at zero)
labGamePage.expRecallHint: Recalling early only brings back part of the loot (elapsed time × 70%). Recall now?
labGamePage.expResultRecall: Recalled early · only part of the loot
labGamePage.expLootLost: Warehouse full — some loot was left behind
labGamePage.raidForecast: 📰 Horde forecast: tonight at {h}:00 a horde of about {x} strength will attack from the {side}!
labGamePage.raidHordeHint: From {h}:00 a horde of ~{x} (power {p}) attacks from the {side}; that wall wears out faster
labGamePage.raidBreach: The horde broke through the {side} wall! Buildings damaged, villagers hurt, everyone slacks off for 24h
labGamePage.waveDesc: Once on, a wave strikes every night at 22:00 sharp — the next comes the following evening, with only 1 hour between the last two. 7 waves total, power climbing; better defense earns rarer loot
labGamePage.waveOnToast: Challenge on: {m} waves, battles at 22:00 nightly
labGamePage.waveResumeToast: Challenge resumed from the next wave
labGamePage.waveCloseToast: Challenge closed — reopen before the next wave
labGamePage.waveFirstKill: ★ First Blood Tide kill! Bonus: Nether Star ×1 + Emerald ×150
labGamePage.bossEscaped: {n} vanished into the dark — the village reels!
labGamePage.traderAway: Not here right now (visits at random hours)
labGamePage.traderHint: The Wandering Trader visits at a random hour daily and stays {n}h; smelt sand into glass at the Smithy
labGamePage.collectHint: Output is stored in the building until collected
labGamePage.staffHint: {n} worker(s) short — running below full power
labGamePage.fuelHint: Output consumes fuel; charcoal {c} / log {l} per unit, auto-refilled from the selected fuel when short
labGamePage.fuelNoStock: Not enough of the selected fuel
labGamePage.autoEatHint: Auto-eat below 30 satiety (lowest-tier first; rotten flesh last and causes hunger)
labGamePage.devResetConfirm: This clears all buildings, villagers and resources. Reset?
labGamePage.ugClearConfirm: Spend {s} and wait {t} min to clear this underground plot? Yields Raw Iron, small chance of Gold Ingots.
labGamePage.raidHint: Storage holds up to 8 hours of drops; excess is lost
labGamePage.foodHint: Foods at the top are eaten first; Rotten Flesh stays last by default. Only foods in stock are shown — eaten-out foods hide automatically
labGamePage.logNotice: Village notice: welcome! Food priority & night raids are now live.
labGamePage.mktStackCapHint: One stack per slot: {n} of this item
labGamePage.mktGridHint: First 6 slots: selling · Last 3: buying · Priced in emeralds
labGamePage.mktVisitSoon: Trading is under development. Stay tuned
labGamePage.blHint: Rates per hour at full staffing
labGamePage.storeConfirm: Store this building into the warehouse ({s})? Re-place it anytime from the Building List. Level, durability and stored output are kept.
labGamePage.placeHint: Tap an empty plot to place {n}
labGamePage.placeGround: This building can only be placed on the ground layer
